Isolate stuck provider shutdown and cancellation

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-16
  description: |-
    Bound daemon runtime shutdown so permanently stuck blocking provider calls cannot hold process exit. Reserve independently bounded cancellation capacity and route exact provider cancellations through it. Retain per-dispatch Cursor and Grok process-group termination handles while sessions are owned by in-flight blocking calls, with cleanup after successful teardown. Add deterministic supervisor, subprocess shutdown, and per-provider termination tests.
